narrative.overview: SIPENA-KTT serves Tim Neraca Wilayah dan Analisis Statistik (Nerwilis) at BPS Kabupaten Tana Tidung (65.04). The visual system mirrors an authoritative regional accounts dossier: crisp daylight surfaces led by cool paper neutrals, anchored along the left edge by a sovereign BPS Maritime Navy navigation spine, and engineered to shift cleanly into calibrated obsidian slate when toggled to Dark Mode for evening reconciliation sessions.
keyCharacteristics: Daylight-first #f4f6fa canvas and pure #ffffff analytical paper paired with persistent #0a2540 navigation rail (#080d16 and #101827 in Dark Mode).

Two-font statistical discipline: Plus Jakarta Sans for Indonesian journalism prose and decisions, strictly paired with JetBrains Mono (tabular-nums) for KBLI indices, timestamps, counts, and numerical metrics.
Top-layer <dialog> review architecture placing raw media citations opposite human-in-the-loop taxonomy controls with keyboard triage (J/K, Enter, [A], [R], Esc).
Complete WCAG 2.1 AA contrast compliance (>= 4.5:1 body text, >= 3:1 structural control outlines) across Light and Dark modes, plus non-color iconography in status badges.

rules.name: The Cobalt Restraint Rule
rules.body: Primary cobalt ink and fills mark interactive triggers, active focus outlines, and drill-down destinations only. Categorical badges keep neutral surfaces paired with compact color index tiles so tabular scanning stays calm.

rules.name: The Dual-Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Every semantic surface, input, scrollbar, dialog backdrop, and badge defines verified Light and Dark contrast tokens. Switching sipena-theme never leaves dark-on-dark or pale-on-white artifacts.

rules.name: The Earned Monospace Rule
rules.body: Monospace lettering appears strictly on identifiers, quantitative counters, timestamps, and keyboard shortcuts. Narrative headings and prose always render in Plus Jakarta Sans.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Content tables and distribution panels separate via clean surface contrast and 1px seams. Only top-layer overlays and primary entry cards cast directional shadows.

dos: Do validate Contrast (>= 4.5:1 normal text, >= 3:1 borders and UI indicators) and full interactive layout across both Light (sipena-theme=light) and Dark (sipena-theme=dark) modes.
Do keep narrative copy strictly authentic to BPS Kab. Tana Tidung (65.04) operations with zero em dash characters (U+2014) and real Postgres-backed counts.
Do maintain visible labels and helpful empty, loading skeleton, error retry, and read-only viewer states on every module.
donts: Don't apply pill rounding (rounded-full) to buttons, badges, inputs, or cards, or scatter colored border-left accent bars onto cards.
Don't introduce external font CDN links, unapproved images, AI buzzword copy, or infinite animate-pulse / glowing status dots.
Don't suppress focus rings or build non-semantic clickable <div> elements instead of native <button> and <a href> controls.
